_comment: Test pipeline baselines. Update deliberately when counts legitimately change. wrapper_stripped_count is the block count the GENERATOR's own SwiftWrapperPostProcessor.Process strips from the wrapper (the harness reuses that oracle; it no longer over-strips valid conformances). 35->1 in Session 7b (the old 35 was the retired bespoke harness stripper's over-strip count; Process stripped exactly 1: the InternalHolder.describe internal-receiver wrapper). 1->0 in Step 8a: the sync internal-receiver case is now closed AT EMISSION — WrapperValidation.GetMemberRejectionReason gate 2b (parent_module_internal) rejects the @_cdecl wrapper for a public Method/Constructor/Property/Subscript whose PARENT type is module-internal, so the member falls back to a direct CallConvSwift P/Invoke instead of emitting-then-stripping. Nothing is left for Process to strip — including the InternalHolder public get-only subscript added in Step 8a to exercise the subscript arm (it would emit-then-strip without the gate; the gate keeps the count at 0). The gate fails on any INCREASE — a NEW uncompilable emission (e.g. an async/closure/operator internal-receiver wrapper, deliberately still post-processor-scoped, or a regression that re-emits a sync Method/Constructor/Property/Subscript one). Reseed with `nuke seed-wrapper-strip-baseline`.
_coverage_comment: Coverage ratchet budgets enforced by build/scripts/coverage-report.py (compare_coverage_baseline). Each count is the accepted ceiling; the gate fails on any INCREASE and reports decreases as improvements to tighten. must_pass_degraded = must-pass features whose binding compiles but skips ≥1 member; must_pass_compiled_out = must-pass features whose binding member(s) were compiled out for this SDK; must_pass_passing_untested = must-pass features that bind cleanly but have no runtime test referencing them in RuntimeTestsApp; known_unsupported_total = declared known-unsupported features. Seeded from a fresh compile-only run under the CI Xcode. generator_exit_code was removed: it duplicated the regen-exit gate (a non-zero generator exit already hard-fails --compile-only) and nothing read it.
